summary: Iteration 8 (daily-reward + level stars + first-time tutorial + sparkle burst + unified icons). Backend: 58/59 pytest green — added TestDailyReward (4 tests: status shape+cycle==DAILY_REWARDS, claim grants coins/bells+increments streak+persists, second same-day claim -> HTTP 400 + status not claimable, 404s) and TestLevelStars (4 tests: stores best-of stars per level dict, 0 not stored, ignored when not completed, defaults empty for new player + daily_streak=0/last_reward_date=null). The one pre-existing failure (TestWeeklyLeaderboard::test_complete_level_updates_weekly_max) is unrelated to iter-8 and caused by preview-env leaderboard pollution — the seeded player falls outside the top-20 rows. Iter-6/7 regressions all green: player CRUD, complete-level unlock chain (soft_pretzel -> happy_cakes), spend-bells, upgrades (grill/pantry/plates/holding), coin-packs, bell-packs, RevenueCat webhook (coins+bells, idempotent, unknown/ignored). Frontend (mobile 390x844): (1) fresh onboarding via username-input + create-player-button lands on home-screen with bell-balance + coin-balance; the LOVE sculpture (red LO/VE with tilted O), Liberty Bell PNG chip, and Independence Hall/pretzel iconography all render (see /tmp/home_i8.png). (2) Opening level-1 (Soft Pretzel) shows tutorial-overlay with all 3 numbered steps (Swap tiles / Collect items / Serve orders) — tutorial-got-it dismisses it, and revisiting level-1 (via back to level-map -> level-1) does NOT re-show it (AsyncStorage flag_tutorial_pretzel gate works). Game screen renders board and all 5 base-recipe goals: recipe-dough, recipe-salt, recipe-cheese_sauce, recipe-mustard, recipe-pizza_sauce. (3) cooking-result stars-row correctly renders 3 gold ★ for stars=3, 1 gold + 2 dim for stars=1, and is HIDDEN on failure (completed=0, stars=0) — LEVEL FAILED path unaffected. unlock-banner shows 'NEXT UP 🧁 Happy Cakes'. (4) After POSTing complete-level {level:1, stars:3} the level-map redraws Soft Pretzel node with ★★★ under the label and a ✓ done state, and Happy Cakes (Lvl 2) becomes unlocked with an empty (dim) star row — matches the design (see /tmp/levelmap_stars.png). (5) Shop daily-reward-card shows Daily Reward header, '🔥 0 day streak', +25 🪙 reward, and a 7-dot cycle (bells icons on days 3/5/7); tapping claim-reward-button increases coins 100 -> 125, flips button to disabled 'Come back tomorrow ✓', updates streak text to '🔥 1 day streak', and a second click is inert (button disabled). No React Native red screen, no PAGEERROR events. Only expected RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow*/textShadow*/Image.style.resizeMode). Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. Sparkle-burst overlay (testID='sparkle-burst', pointerEvents='none') is code-verified: trigger fires exactly when perfect===true in serve.tsx:222 via setSparkle((s)=>s+1). Full serve loop end-to-end was already validated in iter-7 and remains unchanged.

minor.issue: Pre-existing/environmental: test_complete_level_updates_weekly_max fails because the preview DB has >20 TEST_ players with weekly scores > 300, so the freshly-seeded player is pushed out of the returned top-20. Not a code bug in iter-8; consider (a) capping leaderboard by player_id list in tests, (b) or bumping to top-500 in the endpoint.

action_items: Optional: fix pre-existing TestWeeklyLeaderboard::test_complete_level_updates_weekly_max flake by asserting via a filter (e.g., fetch player directly) instead of scanning the top-20 leaderboard rows, or clean out TEST_* players between preview runs.
Optional: set REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_AUTH before production so the webhook rejects unauth calls (still open from iter-7).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py daily-reward: DAILY_REWARDS is a 7-item cycle indexed by `(max(1, streak) - 1) % 7`; claim increments streak only when today - last_reward_date == 1 day, else resets to 1 — matches PRD 'daily reward streak' semantics.

server.py claim-daily-reward is idempotent per UTC date via the `last == today` check and returns HTTP 400 on second same-day call, verified by TestDailyReward::test_second_claim_same_day_returns_400.

server.py complete-level correctly stores BEST stars per level: `stars[key] = max(int(stars.get(key, 0)), int(result.stars))` and only when `result.completed and result.stars > 0` — verified across up/down/zero/failed cases in TestLevelStars.

player_public exposes both `stars` (dict) and `daily_streak`/`last_reward_date`, so the level-map and shop can render off a single GET /players/{id} without extra endpoints — good, and confirmed by iteration_8 UI test.

frontend/app/game.tsx tutorial gate uses an AsyncStorage flag (`flag_tutorial_pretzel`) — confirmed via UI test that returning to level-1 does not re-show the overlay. testID='tutorial-overlay' + testID='tutorial-got-it' present.
frontend/app/cooking-result.tsx renders stars-row only when `stars > 0`, so failed levels don't show a bogus 0-star row — this matches the design decision and was verified.

frontend/src/components/SparkleBurst.tsx is a pointerEvents='none' animated overlay driven by a numeric `trigger` prop, and serve.tsx increments it exclusively inside the `if (perfect)` branch (line 222) — no leaks on failed serves.
